resumeText:
Sneha Iyer | Bengaluru, Karnataka | sneha.iyer.bi@example.com

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Information Technology, Dayananda Sagar Institute of Technology, Bengaluru (2022 - 2026) | CGPA 8.6/10

INTERNSHIP
Data Analyst Intern (Power BI), Kaveri Retail Analytics, Bengaluru (May 2025 - Jul 2025, 12 weeks)
- Built a Power BI sales dashboard for 40 stores showing daily revenue, footfall and top categories.
- Cleaned and merged monthly Excel sales files with Power Query before loading them into the report.
- Wrote SQL queries in MySQL to pull store-wise returns data for the dashboard.
- Presented the dashboard to the regional sales manager and five store leads in a weekly review call.

PROJECTS
- IPL Analytics (personal): Designed an interactive Power BI report with bar charts, slicers and a map of match venues from ball-by-ball data.
- Hospital Bed Tracker (academic, DBMS course): Designed tables for wards, beds and admissions and wrote SQL joins to report bed occupancy by ward.

CERTIFICATIONS AND COURSEWORK
- Microsoft PL-300 study path (in progress)
- Coursework: DBMS, Data Warehousing and Mining, Probability and Statistics, Python Programming

SKILLS
Power BI, DAX basics, Power Query, SQL (MySQL), Star schema, ETL concepts, Excel, Python (pandas)

ACTIVITIES
- Organised the department data hackathon with 200 participants
- Classical dance (Bharatanatyam), performed at college annual day
